required_permissions: Classic Environment API token: metrics.read, entities.read, problems.read, events.read for the selected capabilities

Platform OAuth client or token: storage:logs:read, storage:events:read, storage:spans:read, storage:metrics:read, storage:entities:read, storage:smartscape:read and storage:buckets:read on approved buckets only
Lifecycle and load-phase webhooks: an events.ingest token on the receiving environment

capabilities.name: metrics
capabilities.summary: Classic metric buckets and Grail numeric series
capabilities.remaining: A licensed non-production SaaS tenant: record the tenant release and Environment API capabilities

capabilities.name: diagnostics
capabilities.remaining: Live problems and events with entity scope on a tenant

capabilities.name: grail_queries

capabilities.name: trace_lookup

capabilities.remaining: A SUT instrumented by OneAgent or OTel ingest that propagates the run's traceparent

capabilities.name: run_header
capabilities.summary: Diagnostics correlated by the opt-in run header
capabilities.remaining: Request-attribute capture of the run header on a tenant

capabilities.name: deep_links
capabilities.remaining: Confirm the trace app URL and timeframe parameters on a live tenant
